roonf.2025.2.3.source_variant_note: Problems © Ministerul Educației (Olimpiada Națională de Fizică). Translated from the official Romanian paper as published on olimpiade.ro (Olimpiada Națională de Fizică, Slobozia, 10–15 aprilie 2025, proba teoretică, clasa a X-a); the Romanian original is kept. Left out: the paper header (ministry and olympiad logos, page numbers), the five general instructions to candidates printed at the foot of every page (separate sheet per problem, any order, 3 hours, non-programmable calculators, each problem marked from 10 to 0) and the list of the authors of the problems at the end; the PDF contains no solutions or marking scheme. The heading 'Subiectul n' is rendered as 'Problema n' / 'Problem n'. Decimal commas are kept in the Romanian text and written as decimal points in the English translation. Points are printed (10 points; A 3, B 3, C 4) and kept. The table 'Tabelul nr. 1' is transcribed as an array. Kept as printed: the symbol κ reused in part B for the solar energy flux (1200 W·m⁻²) after denoting thermal conductivity in part A; the reference 'punctul 1.a.' in part b (meaning part a of this problem); the typos 'statul de cărămidă' (for 'stratul'; translated as 'layer'), 'câteva problemele', 'Expresia fluxul', 'Conform proiectul'; the electrical power P_el = 1152 W stated twice (day and night); in part f the current through BC is called I_5 although the figure labels only I, I_1, I_2, I_3. The captions 'Figura C1' and 'Figura C2' are also inside the cropped figures.
